body:
Adds `research/finetune-twin` (builds on HIRO/ARPG sim-to-real directions; no affiliation implied).

- Exact expected SGD loss after k real steps from a twin start on a quadratic; matches Monte Carlo within 0.3%.
- A twin start with 0.6x the cold-start error saves 64–67% of steps; zero at equal error; negative transfer beyond (−138 steps at 1.5x).
- For any spectrum, twin-error loss after k steps is ≤ b²/(4eηk), attained within 3% by λ*=1/(2ηk) (1/k, not geometric).
- Same initial loss: stiff-direction error needs 13 steps, flat-direction 1,541.
- 8 tests pass; README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Stylised (fixed parameter offset, isotropic noise, no robot data); preliminary.
